-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies WebSocket connectivity to backend.

admin-infra-backend-status.name: admin-infra-backend-status
admin-infra-backend-status.description: Get current status of the Teros backend including uptime, memory usage, process info, and number of running MCAs.

admin-infra-restart-backend.name: admin-infra-restart-backend
admin-infra-restart-backend.description: Restart the Teros backend server. This will gracefully shutdown all MCA processes and restart the backend. Use with caution - this will temporarily interrupt service.

params.confirm: Confirmation flag - must be true to proceed with restart

admin-infra-sync.name: admin-infra-sync
admin-infra-sync.description: Sync MCAs, models, and tools from filesystem to database. Run this after adding or modifying MCAs.

admin-infra-mca-status.name: admin-infra-mca-status
admin-infra-mca-status.description: Get status of all running MCA processes. Super admin only.

admin-infra-mca-kill.name: admin-infra-mca-kill
admin-infra-mca-kill.description: Kill a running MCA process by ID. Super admin only. DESTRUCTIVE — use with caution.

admin-infra-mca-cleanup.name: admin-infra-mca-cleanup
admin-infra-mca-cleanup.description: Clean up stale or dead MCA processes. Super admin only. DESTRUCTIVE — use with caution.

admin-infra-mca-health.name: admin-infra-mca-health
admin-infra-mca-health.description: Run health checks on all MCA processes. Super admin only.

name: Teros Admin Infra
description: Infrastructure tools for managing the Teros backend: backend status, restart, sync, and MCA process management (status, kill, cleanup, health checks).

changelog.notes: Check backend status, restart and sync the server, and monitor, kill, clean up and health-check app processes
